exposure: routine rapid insertion of a Bakri balloon during cesarean section for placenta previa
cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies who underwent cesarean section for placenta previa between 2003 and 2016
finding: Routine rapid insertion of Bakri balloon tamponade during cesarean section for placenta previa significantly decreased intra- and postoperative hemorrhage and shortened the surgical duration.
mod_finding: Routine rapid insertion of a Bakri balloon during cesarean section for placenta previa significantly reduced intra- and postoperative hemorrhage and shortened surgical duration.
